public_authority_sources.what_it_proves: The County says the Wild Rose Power Hub ASP covers a primarily data-centre project, identifies three quarter sections, and gives official plan location POINT (-113.714161 50.943554).

The provincial project page describes Wild Rose Power Hub as a proposed hyperscale data centre, gives developer Chinook Development LP, states the approximate 194-hectare/479-acre area and identifies the project as proposed.

public_authority_sources.publisher: Rocky View County Terms of Reference
public_authority_sources.what_it_proves: County terms of reference identify the Wild Rose Power Hub ASP as a developer-funded data-centre project and describe the site/planning process.

disposition.meaning: The previously unresolved project/load signal can now be linked to a named proposed data-centre development and an official planning point/parcel set.
